title: eludite/solution/edit
description: Brief 0081: edit the open solution file (.sln or .slnx) as Visual Studio's Workspace window does: add an existing project, remove a project, add, rename and remove a solution folder, add and remove a solution item (a file in a solution folder), and set a project's build dependencies (Project Dependencies). The host edits the text in place: every byte outside the lines it adds, changes or removes stays as it was (encoding, byte order mark, line endings, indentation and comments). In a .sln a new project gets a Project block with the project type of its extension (SDK or legacy) and a new GUID, and a ProjectConfigurationPlatforms line pair per solution configuration (the project's Debug or Release with Any CPU); removing a project removes its block, its configuration lines, its NestedProjects line and every ProjectDependencies line naming it. A .slnx gets <Project Path="..."/> (inside the folder's <Folder> when given) with the indentation of its siblings. When anything was written the host reloads the solution (the generation moves on and eludite/solution/status reports the load). A project file opened alone (no solution) answers -32602.

generation.description: The generation the shell read the tree under. Not the current generation: -32801 (ContentModified), nothing written.

action.description: addProject: project (and folder). removeProject: project. addFolder: name (and folder: the parent). renameFolder: folder, name. removeFolder: folder (with everything in it: its projects leave the solution, as in Visual Studio). addFile: folder, file. removeFile: folder, file. setDependencies: project, dependsOn (the whole list).

project.description: Absolute path of a project file (.csproj, .vbproj, .fsproj). For addProject it must exist and not be in the solution yet.

folder.description: A solution folder's path (/src/, /src/tests/), as eludite/solution/tree's folders give it.

name.description: A folder name: no slash, backslash, colon, asterisk, question mark, quote, angle bracket or bar; unique among its siblings, case-insensitively.

file.description: Absolute path of a file (a solution item).

dependsOn.description: setDependencies: absolute paths of the projects of the solution this one builds after.

generation.description: The generation after the call: one more than the request's when a file was written (the host reloaded the solution), else the same.

path.description: Absolute path of the solution file.

written.description: True when the file changed on disk.

folder.description: addFolder and renameFolder: the folder's path after the edit.

message.description: Why nothing was written, when the edit was a no-op (already in the solution, already absent).
